I am Professor in the Information Technology Department at the Institute of Engineering & Technology (IET), which is a teaching department of Devi Ahilya University, Indore (DAVV). I completed my undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering from Government Engineering College, Jabalpur, and later pursued my M.Tech. in Energy Management from DAVV. After joining IET, the institute sponsored my second postgraduate degree, and I successfully completed my M.Tech. in Computer Science. I was awarded a Ph.D. in Computer Engineering in 2011.

At both the institute and university levels, I hold various responsibilities. Currently, I serve as the Director, Institute of Engineering & Technology (25+ yrs old engineering institute with 3000+ students on campus), Direcor, Centre for Distance and Online Education and Director of the Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC). I served as Dean of the Faculty of Engineering and Executive Council Member (Under Dean Category) for the two years.

I have established the Heat Transfer and Refrigeration Laboratory within the Mechanical Engineering Department. I have played a key role in the development and implementation of Management Information Systems (MIS), the design and redesign of various forms to improve information flow, website development, document repository management, workflow systems, compliance reporting for organizations such as AICTE and NAAC SSR, World Bank Project Reports, the institute's brochures and magazines, co-curricular and extra-curricular activities, curriculum design, and energy audits, among other initiatives.

I have also contributed to the institution as Professor In-Charge of the Civil Engineering Department, Hostel Warden and at the university level by serving as the Coordinator of the Career and Development Cell, Officer on Special Duty (OSD) for the Central Valuation Centre at DAVV, and as a member of various committees related to corporate life enrichment, including youth festivals, convocations, the University Examination Automation Committee, and the University Website Reform Committee. Additionally, I served as the Vice- President of the CSI Indore Chapter.

I have further contributed to society by serving as the National Coordinator for Vidyarthi Vigyan Mantahn, a project aimed at school-level students by Vigyan Bharati, an NGO working for the National Science Movement. I am also an active member of the NGO Art of Living. Currently, having responsibility of Secretary, Vigyan Bharati Malwa Prant.

In addition to my teaching responsibilities, I took on the role of the Training & Placement Department Head at IET and made significant contributions to enhancing the institute's industry interaction and collaboration with the university.

I also served on deputation as the Group CEO for a rapidly growing chemical group for one year. The objective of this assignment was to instill a culture of systems thinking in the group's day-to-day operations, leading to resource optimization and cost reduction.
Furthermore, I attended a four-day Academic Leadership Training Program conducted by MHRD at CUSB, Bodhgaya from February 19th to 22nd, 2018.
I am also advising some of the software companies for HR Training, Systems and Planning.
My areas of interest include Enterprise Resource Planning, Knowledge Management, E-Commerce, and Digital Forensics.
I have taken responsibility of Director, Institute of Engineering & Technology, Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore on 10th July 2025.
